claims.citation: New York Herald, 31 July 1866, p. 9, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Borussia (Ham), Schwensen, Hamburg, 15th
and Southampton 18th inst, with mdse and 541 passengers,
to Kunhardt & Co. 18th inst, off Start Point, passed
ship Star of Peace (Am), from London for Mauritius; off
Landsend, steamship Bavaria, hence for Hamburg; 19th, lat
49 34, lon 12 21, ship Buffalo, from Quebec, bound E; 22d,
lat 49 37, lon 29 30, steamship City of London, hence for Liv-
erpool; 25th, lat 46 30[?], lon 50 34, bark Celeste Clark, from
Gottenburg for New York; 28th, lat 41 03[?], lon 65 35, ship
Lewis, and bark Argonaut, both bound W.

claims.citation: Hubbard & Winter, North Atlantic Mail Sailings 1840-75 (USPCS, 1988; rev. 2014), p. 179

claims.verbatim:
Steamship Borussia (Hamb.), Schwensen, Hamburg July 18[?], and
Southampton the 18th[?], with mdse. and 541[?] pass. to Kunhardt & Co.
July 19[?], off Start Point, passed American steamship Star of Peace,
bound W.; off Landsend, steamship Bavaria, bound E.; 19th[?] inst., in
lat. 49 34[?], long. 12 21[?], ship Buffalo, from Quebec, bound E; 22d inst.,
in lat. 49 37[?], long. 28 30[?], steamship City of London, bound E; 25th[?]
in lat. 46 30[?], long. 50 24[?], bark Celeste Clark, bound W; 28th[?] inst., in
lat. 41 03[?], long. 65 25[?], ship Lewis, bound W, also the bark Orgasant[?],
bound W.
